subject: general
question: What is the full form of EVM?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electronic Voting Machine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **EVM** is an **Electronic Voting Machine**, to conduct free and fair elections electronically voting machines were introduced.
 
• EVM was first introduced in Indian elections between **1998 and 2001**. 
 
• Recently used in state elections conducted in five Indian states in 2017.
 
• The technology has eliminated **paper ballots** in the local, state, and general elections.
 
• It supports a smooth election with technological advancement.
 
• EVMs are the most excellent way to avoid election malpractices, as per the given Indian population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian electronic voting machine (EVM) was developed in **1989** by the **Election Commission of India** in collaboration with Bharat Electronics Limited and Electronics Corporation of India Limited.
 
• The designers of the EVMs were the faculty members of the Industrial Design Centre, **IIT Bombay**.
 
• The EVMs were first used in 1982 in Kerala for a limited number of polling stations.
 
• The EVMs were first time used on an experimental basis in constituencies of Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Delhi.
 
• The EVMs were used first time in the general election to the assembly of Goa in 1999.
 
• In 2003, all by-elections and state elections were held using EVMs, encouraged by this election commission decided to use only EVMs for Lok Sabha elections in 2004.
